 The Xiaomi 11.11 Mega Sale runs from November 6 to 15, 2026, across Shopee and Lazada, with discounts advertised at up to PHP 13,000 on Xiaomi products and up to PHP 15,000 on POCO devices. The sale covers flagship smartphones, high-performance gaming rigs, tablets, smart home essentials, and wearables.
 What the discounts look like
 For POCO devices, the biggest discount will be for the POCO F6 Pro 12GB + 512GB, variant, which is priced at PHP 29,999 from PHP 44,999. The POCO F8 Ultra 12GB + 256GB follows at PHP 41,999 from PHP 52,999 and the 16GB + 512GB for PHP 44,999 from PHP 53,999.
 On the Xiaomi side, the Xiaomi PAD 7 at 8GB + 128GB model drops to PHP 18,999 from PHP 25,999, and the Xiaomi PAD 6 at the same configuration is priced at PHP 21,999 from PHP 26,499. The Redmi 17 4G 4GB + 128GB variant goes to PHP 11,999 from PHP 12,999, and the REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G 8GB + 256GB model for PHP 22,999 from PHP 24,999.

 When the prices drop
 Shopee runs the Xiaomi 11.11 sale from November 6 to 15. Lazada starts later, at 8:00 PM on November 10, and closes on November 15.
 The peak window runs from 8:00 PM on November 10 through November 11, when the campaign’s biggest discounts drop. Free shipping, additional discount vouchers and Buy Now Pay Later options apply across the sale.

 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
 + When is the Xiaomi 11.11 Mega Sale? 
 From November 6 to 15, 2026, with Lazada starting at 8:00 PM on November 10.
 + How much can I save? 
 Up to PHP 13,000 on Xiaomi products and up to PHP 15,000 on POCO devices, as advertised.
 + What is the biggest POCO discount? 
 The POCO F6 Pro at 12GB + 512GB, which drops to PHP 29,999 from PHP 44,999.
 + When are the flash deals? 
 From 8:00 PM on November 10 through November 11, the sale’s peak window.
 + Are the freebies on every item? 
 No. The free Xiaomi Mi Casual Daypack comes with the six listed bundles only.
